 Argentina vs. Costa Rica - Head-to-head record
 Argentina and Costa Rica have met on several occasions over the years , although their recent encounters have been relatively infrequent.
 Their latest meeting took place in March 2024, when Argentina secured a 3-1 victory in an international friendly. Costa Rica took the lead in that match, but the South Americans responded with three second-half goals to complete the comeback.
 That result highlights Argentina’s attacking quality, although the two sides have changed considerably since their last encounter. With Scaloni expected to field several younger players, Tuesday’s friendly offers another opportunity for Costa Rica to test themselves against high-level opposition.

 Argentina Albiceleste Looking to Bounce Back
 Argentina enter their final international fixture of 2026 hoping to respond to their recent defeat against Uruguay. With Lionel Scaloni expected to make changes to his starting XI, let’s examine their recent performances and team news.
 Recent form
 Argentina have enjoyed a strong run of results in recent months, winning three consecutive matches before suffering a 2-1 defeat to Uruguay at La Bombonera on Friday. Their previous victories included a 4-0 success over Bolivia, a 7-0 win against Burkina Faso and a 3-0 triumph over Benin.
 Those results demonstrated Argentina’s considerable attacking strength , with the team scoring 14 goals across those three victories. However, their defeat to Uruguay exposed areas for improvement as Scaloni continues to reshape his squad following Lionel Messi’s international retirement.

 Costa Rica have struggled for consistency in recent months, particularly against stronger international opponents. Bryan Ruiz’s side will be hoping to deliver a competitive performance in C처rdoba after their recent defeat to Ecuador.

 Their latest fixture ended in a 2-0 loss to Ecuador on Saturday, extending their difficulties against South American opposition . Costa Rica have struggled to maintain defensive organisation against stronger teams, an issue that could prove costly against Argentina’s attacking players.
 The visitors have also endured a difficult run in international friendlies, failing to win any of their last five matches in that category. During that sequence, they scored just three goals while conceding 15.
